name: Cloud image should reference build artifact
description: A service running in your cloud was matched to an artifact from your build system by name but not by hash.
detailedDescription: An image name not matched to a build artifact by hash or name may indicate a compromise of the cloud account. An unauthorized application may be running in your organization's cloud. A crypto miner is an example of this.
